characterList.description: A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a light blue shirt.
characterList.name: Liju Jacob

content_metadata.description: An instructional video by Liju Jacob explaining the process and importance of writing petitions to Kerala government offices.

qAndA.question: What is the standard paper size recommended for writing petitions to Kerala government offices?

qAndA.answer: A phone number, and an email ID if available.
qAndA.question: What detail about the sender must be included on the petition, besides the name and address?

qAndA.answer: "ശ്രീമാന്" ("Sriman") which is equivalent to "Sir" in English.
qAndA.question: What is the phrase used in Malayalam to address the recipient of the petition?

qAndA.answer: The receipt serves as proof that the petition was received by the office and provides a reference number for any follow-up inquiries.
qAndA.question: Why is it important to get a receipt when submitting a petition?

qAndA.answer: The mood is calm and informative, conveyed through Liju Jacob's clear and patient explanation, his direct engagement with the viewers, and the use of simple visuals and text.
qAndA.question: What is the mood of the video and how is it conveyed?

activities.description: Discusses the need for knowing how to write petitions

characterInteraction.description: Liju Jacob addresses the viewers directly.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Emphasizes the empowering aspect of being able to independently communicate with government offices.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces the topic of writing petitions in Malayalam for Kerala government offices.
He highlights the common need for writing petitions and the confusion people face.

scenes.thematicElements: Importance of communication with government offices, need for clear and correct petition writing.
scenes.title: Introduction to Petition Writing

videoEditingDetails.description: Animated intro with Liju Jacob's photo and channel name "Liju's Corner"
Background changes to a red and white patterned cloth
Text appears on screen: "LIJU JACOB Writer, Adolescents Trainer"
Subtitles in Malayalam appear on screen

activities.description: Explains the format of a petition.
Provides step-by-step instructions on how to write a petition.
Discusses the importance of acknowledgment receipts.
Explains how to write follow-up petitions.

characterInteraction.description: Liju Jacob continues to address the viewers directly, providing clear instructions.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Promotes self-reliance and awareness of citizens' rights.

narrativeProgression.description: Liju Jacob introduces the A4 paper as the standard format.
He walks through the petition structure, covering sender details, recipient details, subject, content, acknowledgments, and enclosures.
He highlights the importance of getting receipts as proof of submission.
He explains how to write follow-up petitions using previous petition numbers for reference.

scenes.thematicElements: Practical application of knowledge, importance of documentation, process of government communication.
scenes.title: Detailed Petition Writing Instructions

videoEditingDetails.description: Text in Malayalam appears on screen to show an example petition.
Text "Please Subscribe & Share" appears on screen.
More text in Malayalam appears to show an example petition.

narrativeProgression.description: Outro sequence signifies the end of the video.

videoEditingDetails.description: Transition to animated outro with "Thanks For Watching, Like and Share" message and a reminder to subscribe.

climax.description: The importance of getting a receipt is emphasized, marking a peak instructional moment.

storylines.description: Step-by-step guide on writing petitions to Kerala government offices, emphasizing the importance of communication, structure, and documentation.

content_metadata.title: How To Write A Petition To Kerala Government Offices

trimmingSuggestions.description: Some of the repetitions in the instructions for writing the petition could be shortened to make the explanation more concise and engaging.
Visuals could be added to demonstrate the petition writing process, for example, showing Liju Jacob writing on the paper or using a computer to create a digital petition.

youtube_description:
ഒരു ഓഫീസിലേക്കുള്ള പരാതിയോ, അപേക്ഷയോ എഴുതേണ്ടി വരുമ്പോൾ, എത്ര വിദ്യാഭ്യാസവും അറിവും ഉള്ളവർ പോലും സംശയാകുലരാകും. എന്നാൽ ചില അടിസ്ഥാന കാര്യങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞാൽ ഇത് സ്വയം തയ്യാറാക്കാം. അതിന് നിങ്ങളെ ഈ വീഡിയോ സഹായിക്കും.
വീഡിയോ ഇഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടാൽ ചാനൽ Subscribe ചെയ്യുക. like , comment and Share.
